name: blueconic-public-mcp
description: Connects Claude to the public MCP server of your own BlueConic tenant.
long_description:
Connects Claude to the MCP server that runs inside your BlueConic tenant, at https://<tenant>/mcp. The tenant builds its tool set from its own REST API, so the tools follow your tenant rather than a fixed list, and it adds the deterministic search_objects tool that answers a 'how many' question with an exact count instead of the length of one page.

This is the public (tenant) server, and it is read-only. The BlueConic connector in the same repository runs the client locally against the REST API instead; install that one if you need the write operations, which the tenant server does not expose.

Every call carries the read scopes of the OAuth application you configure here, and the tenant filters each answer to what that application's 'run as user' may see.

tenant_url.title: Tenant URL
tenant_url.description: The address of your BlueConic tenant, for example https://tenantname.blueconic.net

client_id.title: OAuth Client ID
client_id.description: The client ID of an OAuth application of your tenant, with client credentials enabled and a run-as user set

client_secret.title: OAuth Client Secret
client_secret.description: The client secret of that same OAuth application

oauth_token.title: OAuth token (optional)
oauth_token.description: Use a token instead of a client ID and secret. When this is set, it is the one that counts.
